    edu.uky.cs.nil.sg
    Data structures for building, pruning, reading, and writing story graphs, which model an interactive narrative where nodes are moments in the story, and nodes are connected by temporal edges that represent how actions change the world's state and epistemic edges that represent what each character believes.
